description: Unit test for PointerLocationEvaluator class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers.tree package, testing pointer location distinctions such as same, above, below, or different.

classes.name: PointerLocationEvaluatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for testing PointerLocationEvaluator behavior with different JsonPointer inputs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes PointerLocationEvaluator instance with a reference JsonPointer before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that PointerLocationEvaluator class and JsonPointer objects used are immutable.

methods.name: evaluationPointerIsDifferent
methods.description: Tests that the evaluator correctly identifies a pointer that points to a different location.

methods.name: evaluationPointerIsAbove
methods.description: Tests that the evaluator recognizes when the evaluation pointer is above the reference pointer.

methods.name: evaluationPointerIsSame
methods.description: Checks that the evaluator correctly identifies when the evaluation pointer is the same as the reference.

methods.name: evaluationPointerIsBelow
methods.description: Tests the evaluator's ability to identify when the evaluation pointer is below the reference pointer.
